security_audit.summary: This is a benign educational skill translated from the official Anthropic cookbooks. All 19 static findings are false positives: the flagged URLs, environment-variable reads, and shell commands are standard documentation for installing tooling and configuring an API key, and the shutil operations belong to a well-secured reference implementation of Claude's memory tool that validates every path against directory traversal. No malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection was found.

content.user_title: Learn Claude API With Cookbook Examples
content.value_statement: Developers often struggle to find working, up-to-date code patterns for the Claude API. This skill provides curated examples, tutorials, and best practices so you can build Claude-powered applications faster.
actual_capabilities: Provides basic Claude API message request examples in Python.
Demonstrates tool use and function calling patterns.
Shows multimodal usage such as image and vision analysis.
Includes a secure reference implementation of the Claude memory tool.
Documents contributor setup and development workflows.
Covers retrieval augmented generation and third-party integration patterns.
limitations: It is a reference and documentation skill, not an executable application.
Some code examples reference older model identifiers that may need updating.
It does not include the full Anthropic cookbook, only selected translated examples.
It does not manage API keys or credentials for the user.

use_cases.title: Learn Claude API basics
use_cases.description: A developer new to the Claude API reads the examples to write a first message request.

use_cases.title: Implement tool use
use_cases.description: An application engineer copies the function-calling patterns to add tools to an existing agent.

use_cases.title: Build a memory backend
use_cases.description: An AI engineer adapts the secure memory tool handler to persist context across sessions.

prompt_templates.title: First API call
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me a minimal Python example that sends a single message to the Claude API and prints the response.
prompt_templates.scenario: Getting started with the Claude API

prompt_templates.title: Add a tool
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the cookbook examples, help me define a get_weather tool and handle the tool_use response from Claude.
prompt_templates.scenario: Adding function calling to an application

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an image
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to send an image to Claude and ask it to describe what the image contains.

prompt_templates.title: Persist memory securely
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how the memory tool handler validates paths, then help me extend it to store user preferences under a per-user directory.
prompt_templates.scenario: Building a stateful agent with persistent memory

output_examples.input: Show me a minimal Python example that sends a message to the Claude API.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a short walkthrough that creates an Anthropic client, calls the messages endpoint with a model and a user message, and reads the text from the response content.

output_examples.input: How does the memory tool prevent directory traversal?
output_examples.output: The skill explains that every path is passed through a validation step that requires a /memories prefix and confirms the resolved path stays inside the memory root, rejecting any attempt to escape the sandbox.

best_practices: Store your Claude API key in an environment variable rather than hardcoding it.
Update model identifiers in examples to the latest supported Claude model before use.
Review any install script before piping it directly to a shell.
anti_patterns: Do not paste your API key directly into example code that may be shared.
Do not run the memory tool handler outside its intended /memories sandbox directory.
Do not treat the examples as production-ready without adding error handling and validation.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It provides code examples and tutorials for building applications with the Claude API.

faq.question: Is this an official Anthropic skill?
faq.answer: It is a community translation of examples from the official Anthropic cookbooks. It is not maintained by Anthropic.

faq.question: Which programming language do the examples use?
faq.answer: The examples are written in Python.

faq.question: Does the skill store my API key?
faq.answer: No. The examples read the API key from an environment variable that you set yourself.

faq.question: Is the memory tool safe to use?
faq.answer: The memory tool handler validates all paths and confines operations to a sandbox directory, but you should still review it before production use.

faq.question: Are the code examples always up to date?
faq.answer: Some examples may reference older model names. Update the model identifier to a current Claude model before running them.
